hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. It handles the entire swap in `beforeSwap` by computing quotes against its internal curve, taking input tokens into an Euler vault, and paying output tokens from another vault, returning a `BeforeSwapDelta` to bypass standard pool manager accounting.
